description.value: Liquidity Wines is an estate winery perched on a hillside in Okanagan Falls, overlooking Vaseux Lake and the iconic McIntyre Bluff, with curated art installations woven throughout the property. Cyclists can stop for wine tastings in the tasting room, share plates in the Tapas Room, or book a night at The Loft on-site accommodation. The winery sits in the heart of the South Okanagan wine country, a region well-travelled by touring cyclists on the Naramata and Okanagan Falls circuits.

address.value: 4720 Allendale Road, Okanagan Falls, BC V0H 1R2
